Sports Minister Honours Commonwealth Games Medalists

Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports, Mansukh Mandaviya, honoured Indian athletes who won medals at the Commonwealth Games 2026. The event took place in New Delhi. The Indian Army also celebrated the athletes' achievement of securing 16 medals at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026. One report mentioned the Sports Minister informing Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal that the Ahmedabad Commonwealth Games would be the grandest with the highest medal tally.
